Dear colleagues at Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 12.87 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 42 days, Incoterm EXW.

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your detailed response and the options provided; we have selected the 30-day payment term as the basis for our revised offer.

Regarding your cost analysis, could you please share the data or benchmarks that led to your target prices? Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
